verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy issues virtual keys that can carry individual spending limits, with max_budget and budget_duration resets, so an agent can get its own capped key. Rate guardrails appear only as an rpm_limit on a team object, so per-key rate limiting is not directly shown. missing for 10: explicit per-key rpm/tpm rate-limit documentation, documented enforcement behavior when a key exceeds its budget or rate (e.g. blocking/rejection), independent or hands-on corroboration of key-level guardrails.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an autonomous agent its own key with budget and rate guardrails so it cannot run away on spend

citations.quote: Personal budgets: Create virtual keys without team_id for individual spending limits
max_budget: 0 # (float) sets max budget as $0 USD  budget_duration: 30d # (str) frequency of reset
